Along Ricci flow, $\lambda (g(t))$ is nondecreasing.
Proof

\sketch Given $t_1<t_2$, solve (15) backward with $u(t_2)=e^{-\bar f(t_2)}$ and put $u=e^{-f}$. Positivity follows by duality with the forward heat kernel, while $\int _Mu(t)dV(t)=1$. Formula (14) and the minimizing property give

\[ \lambda (t_1)\le {\mathcal F}(g(t_1),f(t_1))le {\mathcal F}(g(t_2),f(t_2))=\lambda (t_2). \]

□
